metadata.description: K2 input samples of the three folds (screen, held-out, MeSH): one row per concept-entry event (concept c enters host subfield d in year e) with the outcome Y_strict, the host-share A_cont, the co-primary controls and the partner-generality proxies G_H / G_F. All events of every fold are included (no subsampling).
metadata.label: POST-CONFIRMATION EXPLORATORY

decision_rule.GENERIC ACCESSIBILITY: generality controls remove > 50% of the log-IRR (ret < 0.5)
decision_rule.HOST-SPECIFIC: A_lift CI excludes 1 (M3; CRV1 t(G-1) CI per fold, IVW CI pooled) AND retention >= 0.5
decision_rule.implementation: 'excludes 1' is read as CI entirely above 1 (a CI entirely below 1 is reported as a negative lift and labelled MIXED unless ret < 0.5)
qualifiers: fragile: randomisation p of the focal term (M1 A_cont or M3 A_lift) > 0.05 while CRV1 p < 0.05
decision_rule.reading: the POOLED verdict is the paper's reading; fold verdicts are descriptive

definitions.A_lift: ln((A_cont + c0) / s_dB); c0 = 0.5 x smallest positive A_cont in the fold if any A_cont == 0 (else 0)
definitions.A_spec: entry mean of residuals of tag-level OLS s_pd = a_B + b1 H_p + b2 F_p + b3 ln s_dB (per fold)
definitions.G_H, G_F: tag-count-weighted entry means of H_p, F_p; MeSH: EXACT-profiled tags only (primary)
definitions.G_H_bg: MeSH sensitivity (S8): exact + bg tags, bg entropy from design-weighted shares
definitions.H_p: -sum_d P_pd ln P_pd / ln K_B, P over OBSERVED subfield counts excluding 'unknown'; K_B = #subfields with > 0 works in subfield_year_totals 'all_types' summed over B's five years
definitions.H_p_ub: missing tail (total_known - observed) spread evenly over the K_B - n_observed unobserved subfields
definitions.retention: ret = b_A(M1)/b_A(M0) (= ratio of log-IRR/SD: identical sample and SD); ret_lift = b(M3)/b(M2); pct_removed = 100 (1 - ret)
definitions.s_dB: sum_{y in B} totals(d,y) / sum_{y in B} sum_sf totals(sf,y), 'all_types'
definitions.split_generality: GH_k = sum_{class-k tags} H_p / n_gen_tags (k: NATIVE s>=0.30, ADJACENT 0.05<=s<0.30, FOREIGN s<0.05); same for F
definitions.tag_multiset: entry-year d-paper partner tags (own node dropped), PROFILED tags only (as A_cont)

placebo_host_S10.label: POST-CONFIRMATION EXPLORATORY / SUPPLEMENTARY S10
placebo_host_S10.pass_rule: PASS if share_pos_sig <= 0.10 AND median placebo IRR/SD < 1.10
placebo_host_S10.generic_prediction: FAIL under M1, or share_pos_sig(plac_M1) > share_pos_sig(plac_noG)

s2b_posthoc.label: POST-HOC DIAGNOSTIC (not pre-specified; not in the rule)

screen.note: as specified the oracle is near-collinear (r ~ 0.995): the split between A_cont and the oracle is not identified (SE inflated ~10x), so ret is noise around any value; d2 checks that the total effect is conserved; the well-posed positive control is the Step-3 DGP-G simulation (outcome generated by generality), see d3
